Introduction

Jang Geun Suk is a South Korean actor, singer, and model under CRAFT_42. He began his career as a child model at the age of five and made his acting debut in 1997. He is best known for his leading roles in popular dramas such as You're Beautiful and Mary Stayed Out All Night, as well as for being a member of the fictional idol group A.N.JELL. He made his Korean singing debut in 2008 with the digital single “Black Engine” and his Japanese debut in 2011 with “Let Me Cry.” Jang is also active in Japan as part of the project duo Team H. Fluent in Korean, Japanese, and English, he studied abroad in New Zealand and graduated from Hanyang University’s Department of Theater and Film.
